newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin up four cents to 14.44 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin up four cents to 14.44 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose four cents to close at 14.44 ringgit ($5.81) a kg in tandem with a higher overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The market is just following a higher trend set by the LME," said a Malaysian-based tin trader.

There were initial bids for 94 tonnes against offers for 80. Final turnover was 80 tonnes compared to 104 on Wednesday. Buyers were Europeans, Japanese and locals. The local premium against London was retained at $45.
